model.rules: Reynolds separation + alignment + cohesion (no predator, no leader)
model.integration: one fixed Euler step per draw() frame; velocity clamped to max_speed

render.trails: semi-transparent veil (HSB fill alpha 14) drawn each frame, NOT background()/clear
render.color: by velocity — hue mapped from heading angle (-pi..pi -> 0..360)
render.shape: oriented dart per boid; no chrome, no labels, no controls

gotchas_hit: Trails: lay a low-alpha rect each frame; background()/clear() each frame destroys the trail. (Confirmed visually — the faint trail web is present.)

Background-tab rAF throttling / pause: p5's draw() loop is rAF-driven. In a headless/unfocused harness rAF can be paused entirely (the documented Sketch-tier limit). Added a labeled verification seam (window.__flock = the p5 instance) so frames can be forced via __flock.redraw() when rAF is unavailable; the normal 60 fps loop on a focused tab is untouched.
colorMode(HSB) must be set in setup before any fill; the dark background is then expressed in HSB (240, 30, 6).

verification.method: static server + headless eval/screenshot; window.__flock.redraw() pumped 450 frames (rAF paused in harness)

notes: Same shared model block as the D3 and Plot Specimens (byte-identical computeVelocities; Node-proven deterministic). Trajectory provably identical to the other two. Color-by-velocity makes alignment directly legible as hue coherence — boids on a shared heading share a hue, so a coherent flock reads as a colour field. Sketch tier: focus required for live behaviour.
